fields.description: The price takes effect on this date. Supersession is by the next row's Effective From - there is deliberately no Valid Upto.
fields.label: Effective From

fields.description: Net rate, excluding VAT. Held to 9 decimal places - lower precision silently rounds rates such as 5.172413793 and would then never match a Sales Order line exactly.
fields.label: Rate (net, ex-VAT)
Rate is VAT-inclusive
fields.description: Leave OFF unless the Rate above is a GROSS figure. A rate is normally net, as the Rate label says. Tick it only where a customer's price was agreed inclusive of VAT and the Sales Order is raised with the VAT row set to 'included in print rate', so the invoice lands on the round gross total the customer agreed. The price list is ex-VAT, so the CPS price mirror divides a ticked rate by 1.16 before writing it there.
Reference document or note identifying where this rate came from, for example a quotation or LPO number.
fields.label: Source Reference

fields.description: Only Approved rows can price a Sales Order. Set by the approve / reject action, never by hand. Editing the rate, UOM or effective date of an Approved row returns it to Draft.
fields.label: Approval Status
